extracted.intended_audience: recording artists, remixers, songwriters, producers, engineers/mixers, record labels, and Grammy Awards entrants/submission teams
extracted.subtask_description: Official category definitions and eligibility/nomination rules for multiple GRAMMY Award categories (what recordings/songs/albums qualify, stylistic definitions, nominee designation, and who receives statuettes). Useful for artists, labels, and submission coordinators preparing GRAMMY entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dance/Electronic Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Category is open to recordings specifically and originally targeted to the Dance and/or Electronic market, with significant electronic-based instrumentation generally based around a rhythmic dance beat. Albums must be made up of at least 50% Dance/Electronic recordings to qualify.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums of remixes are not eligible (remixes belong in Best Remixed Recording). Nominees are the Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to the Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Remixed Recording
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in remixed recordings where the remixer takes previously recorded and released material and creatively adds to, alters or transforms it to create a new and unique performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not for covers, re-recordings, remastered releases, or edits that are only shortened versions. Adding a vocal performance without substantive change to the original is not eligible as a remix. Singles/tracks need not be commercially released for sale/streaming if released to clubs or radio in the U.S. for the first time during the eligibility year. The original recording need not have been released in the current eligibility period—only the remixed recording must be first released during the current eligibility period. Only one version/mix of a recording is eligible in the GRAMMY process in most Categories. Remixes of current releases and new remixes of recordings released in a previous awards year are only eligible in Best Remixed Recording. Both the remixed version and the original version must be available to the Academy for judging. Nominee is the Remixer(s). GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Remixer(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Rock Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in a rock performance by a solo artist, collaborating artists, established duo, or established group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Metal Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in a metal performance by a solo artist, collaborating artists, established duo, or established group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Rock Song
rubrics_metrics.description: A Songwriter's Award: Songs entered should represent the best achievement in songwriting across the spectrum of rock music, including metal. Only the merits of the song itself are to be considered. Songs that contain samples or interpolations are eligible. A song must comprise music and lyrics to be eligible in a songwriting Category and must have been released on a recording for the first time, or achieved prominence for the first time, during the current eligibility period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuette awarded to Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Rock Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in albums across the spectrum of rock music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Alternative Music Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in an alternative performance by a solo artist, collaborating artists, established duo, or established group that embraces attributes of progression and innovation in both the music and attitudes associated with it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative Music is often a less intense version of rock or more intense version of pop, regarded as more original, eclectic or musically challenging; may embrace subgenres and hybrids and include performances that do not fit into other genre Categories. Performances on which a group receives artist billing are eligible even when the vocal features only one member—the entire group or collaborative performance determines eligibility. Nominees are the Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to the Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Alternative Music Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in alternative music albums. Alternative Music embraces progression and innovation in music and attitudes; may be less intense rock or more intense pop, original, eclectic, musically challenging, and may include subgenres or hybrids.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to the Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best R&B Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a performance by an R&B solo artist, collaborating artists, established duos, or groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist(s). GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Traditional R&B Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in traditional R&B performance and is intended for recordings that contain classic R&B/Soul vocal, instrumental and compositional elements in a style that distinctly sets its artistic intention apart from a contemporary approach to the genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist(s). GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best R&B Song
rubrics_metrics.description: A Songwriter's Award: Recognizes excellence in R&B songwriting that utilizes a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of R&B music style and culture. Songs that contain samples or interpolations are eligible. A song must comprise music and lyrics to be eligible in a songwriting Category and must have been released on a recording for the first time, or achieved prominence for the first time, during the current eligibility period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Progressive R&B Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of progressive R&B vocal tracks. Intended for artists rooted in R&B elements but with a more progressive sound that may include hip-hop, rap, pop, dance, and electronic music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category differentiated by emphasis on experimentation and innovation, often through unconventional song structures, dynamic production techniques, and multi-genre influences that challenge traditional R&B conventions. Nominee is the Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best R&B Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in albums of R&B music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Rap Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a performance by a solo rap artist, collaborating rap artists, established rap duos, or established rap groups (vocal only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist(s). GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Melodic Rap Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in performances that use the delivery of rap and melody over modern production, requiring a strong and clear presence of melody combined with rap cadence, and inclusive of dialects, lyrics or performance elements from non-rap genres.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Production may include traditional rap elements or elements from non-rap genres. Both the song and melody should be considered to fit these criteria to be accepted in this Category. Nominee is the Artist(s). GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Rap Song
rubrics_metrics.description: A Songwriter's Award: Recognizes excellence in rap music songwriting that utilizes a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of rap music style and culture. Songs that contain samples or interpolations are eligible. A song must comprise music and lyrics to be eligible in a songwriting Category and must have been released on a recording for the first time, or achieved prominence for the first time, during the current eligibility period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuette awarded to Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Rap Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in albums of rap music (vocal performances only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Spoken Word Poetry Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in spoken word poetry albums. Spoken Word or Spoken Word Poetry is an oral poetic performance art that refers to the poem as well as the performers' aesthetic qualities such as intonation, vocal inflections, rhythmic cadence, and musicality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums of spoken word poetry with or without music collaboration or accompaniment are eligible; if recording has musical accompaniment but is primarily spoken word, the spoken word artist is the nominee (musical accompanist(s) may be identified but are not nominees). Recordings that feature song lyrics that are spoken or rapped are eligible in the appropriate genre Categories. Incidental talk or conversation used as an accent does not constitute spoken word poetry. Compilations or excerpts of previously broadcast shows, albums of sound effects, and environmental recordings are not eligible. Nominees are Spoken Word Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Jazz Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a performance by a jazz solo artist, collaborating artists, established duos, or groups, with emphasis on jazz improvisation and ensemble interaction. Jazz instrumental and jazz vocal tracks are both eligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time; for groups: Group Leader and Group Members are nominees if group fewer than ten members; if group is ten or more members, only the Group Leader is designated as a Nominee. GRAMMY statuettes awarded accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Jazz Vocal Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums by jazz vocal soloists, duos, or jazz vocal groups, with specific attention to differentiating elements of vocal performance/interpretation; no language limitations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Solo jazz vocal elements include improvisational phrasing, melodic-based improvisation (lyric, word, or scat), jazz style, and utilization of harmonic/melodic vocabulary found within jazz. Ensemble elements may include rhythm/feel, harmony, inflection, improvisation, arrangement/writing, and phrasing. Vocal performances, styling, arrangements, and interpretation must be jazz in content and tributary to the vocal jazz tradition—not pop/R&B or other non-jazz employing some jazz flavoring. If vocalists and instrumentalists are billed equally, both may be eligible; Academy will determine category based on number of vocal vs instrumental tracks or total playing time. An entire album entered in Jazz Vocal may not be entered again in Jazz Instrumental. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Jazz Instrumental Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums by individuals or groups generally thought of as 'small jazz groups' (typically one to eight musicians), performing jazz music including straight-ahead and contemporary jazz.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include albums with larger back-up ensembles if interaction between soloist(s) and large ensemble supports a small group performance. Size is not determinative—instrumental makeup and how the music is scored matter. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Large Jazz Ensemble Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence on albums of large jazz ensemble performance, primarily recordings with a 'big band sound' or other orchestral jazz recordings that demonstrate orchestrational possibilities of a large ensemble.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generally ensembles must contain nine or more members to be eligible (excluding conductor or bandleader). Ensembles may be billed as ensembles or under a solo artist leader. Recordings that use synthesizers to imitate a large jazz ensemble are not eligible. Large jazz vocal ensemble albums must be entered in Best Jazz Vocal Album. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time (Group Leader and Members if group fewer than ten; if ten or more, only Group Leader designated). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer(s)/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Jazz Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin Jazz albums by ensembles of any size, representing the blending of Jazz and improvisation with Latin and Iberian-American music, Brazilian, and Argentinian tango music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer(s)/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Alternative Jazz Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes artistic excellence in Alternative Jazz albums by individuals, duos, or groups/ensembles, with or without vocals. Alternative Jazz may be defined as a genre-blending, envelope-pushing hybrid mixing jazz elements with other genres and contemporary production techniques/instrumentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include R&B, Hip-Hop, Classical, Contemporary Improvisation, Experimental, Pop, Rap, Electronic/Dance, Spoken Word, or production techniques from other genres. Instrumental albums in the well-established Smooth Jazz style remain in Contemporary Instrumental Category. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Traditional Pop Vocal Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums consisting of a type and style of song and/or performance that cannot properly be intermingled with present forms of pop music; includes new performances of songs from sources such as the Great American Songbook and classic popular music forms of any era, and musical theatre songs independent of a unifying narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings eligible include contemporary pop songs performed in a traditional pop style (reference to style of composition, vocal styling and instrumental arrangement). Songs defined by musical theater qualities (theatrical style of composition, vocal/instrumental performance, arrangement) are eligible as are benefit/tribute/concert/cabaret albums featuring such repertoire. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Instrumental Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Contemporary instrumental music embraces a variety of musical genres; the album concept and production should emphasize instrumental performance, arrangement and/or melodic content and contain contemporary stylistic elements setting it apart from well-established instrumental styles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Musical Theater Album
rubrics_metrics.description: For recordings of the score of a musical theater work created to support an underlying dramatic intention or theme; honors excellence in performances and production of musical theater recordings. Elements of the stage production should not be considered in evaluating the recording.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of revues reflecting a dramatic theme (including repurposed preexisting material) are eligible. Eligible entries must be recordings created to support an underlying dramatic intention; benefit/tribute concerts and concert tour recordings are not eligible; non-musical theater performance albums are not eligible. Nominees are Album Producer(s); Lyricist(s) and Composer(s) of greater than 50% of the score of a new recording of a musical theater work. If any previous recording of said score has been nominated in this category, the composer(s) and lyricist(s) of such shall be ineligible to receive an Award but shall receive a Certificate. Award to up to six (6) Principal Vocalist(s) with significant contributing performance(s) (lead performance by a featured vocalist) OR Achievement Certificates to all vocalists on an 'ensemble-driven piece' (performers have comparable musical and dramatic participation). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Album Producer(s); Lyricist(s) and Composer(s) of greater than 50% of the score of a new recording; Engineer(s)/Mixer(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. Prior nominated composers/lyricists receive Certificates rather than Awards when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Solo Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in recordings of country music performances by solo artists (vocal or instrumental) that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation reflecting the broad spectrum of country music style and culture; intended to recognize music that is reminiscent of the genre's legacy while also engaging contemporary forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominee is the Artist. GRAMMY statuette awarded to the Artist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Duo/Group Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes country music recordings by a duo or group (vocal or instrumental) or collaborations that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of country music style and culture, balancing legacy and contemporary boundary-pushing forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings on which a group receives artist billing are eligible even when the vocal features only one member; the entire group or collaborative performance determines Category eligibility. Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Country Song
rubrics_metrics.description: A Songwriter's Award: Recognizes excellence in songwriting on a country music recording which utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of country music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Traditional Country Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of traditional country music, vocal or instrumental. Traditional country includes recordings that adhere to traditional sound structures, rhythm and singing style, lyrical content, and instrumentation (acoustic guitar, steel guitar, fiddle, banjo, mandolin, piano, electric guitar, live drums) and includes sub-genres like Western, Western Swing, and Outlaw country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Country Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes contemporary country music recordings (vocal or instrumental) which utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility reflecting contemporary country style and culture while remaining relevant to the legacy of country music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best American Roots Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in American Roots Music performance; encompasses all subgenres of the American Roots Field (bluegrass, blues, folk, regional roots styles including Cajun, Hawaiian, Indigenous/Native American, Second Line brass band, Polka, Zydeco, Go-go, Swamp Pop, Conjunto and others).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Americana Performance
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in performances of Americana music: contemporary music that incorporates elements of various American roots music and vocal styles (country, roots-rock, folk, bluegrass, R&B, blues) resulting in a distinctive roots-oriented sound separate from pure forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While acoustic instruments are often present, Americana often uses a full electric band. Nominees are Artist(s). GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best American Roots Song
rubrics_metrics.description: A Songwriter's Award: Recognizes excellence in songwriting in any of the subgenres encompassed in the American Roots Music Field (Americana, bluegrass, blues, folk, or regional roots styles). Instrumentals are not eligible; a song must comprise music and lyrics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Americana Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of Americana music: contemporary music that incorporates elements of American roots music and vocal styles resulting in a distinctive roots-oriented sound, sometimes using full electric band.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Bluegrass Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in bluegrass recordings (vocal or instrumental) that utilize bluegrass acoustic instrumentation (variations of fiddle, banjo, guitar, mandolin, bass, Dobro) and singing style, with production and sensibilities distinct from a pop approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Traditional Blues Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of traditional blues recordings, including traditional structures, harmonic structures and rhythms and traditional instrumentation (acoustic/electric guitar, piano, organ, harmonica, horns, bass, drums), and subgenres such as Delta, Piedmont, jump/swing, Chicago blues, classic/Southern soul.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Blues Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in contemporary blues recordings that vary from traditional blues forms and may employ non-traditional rhythms (funk, hip-hop, reggae, rock), with traditional and non-traditional instruments and contemporary production techniques.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Folk Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in folk recordings in modern and/or traditional vocal and instrumental styles, and original material by artists who utilize traditional and/or modern folk elements, sounds and instrumental techniques as the basis for recordings. Folk music is primarily but not exclusively acoustic, with sensibilities distinct from pop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Regional Roots Music Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes recordings of cultural roots styles (Cajun, Hawaiian, Indigenous/Native American, Second Line brass band, Polka, Zydeco, Go-go, Swamp Pop, Conjunto, others) with production and sensibilities distinct from a pop approach; styles include traditional and/or contemporary musical elements within composition and arrangement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility will be determined by the Screening Committee. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Gospel Performance/Song
rubrics_metrics.description: For artists and songwriters (of new songs): recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative vocal performance and in songwriting (if the song is new) of a traditional Christian, roots gospel or contemporary gospel recording (singles or tracks, vocal only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) & Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s) & Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Christian Music Performance/Song
rubrics_metrics.description: For artists and songwriters (of new songs): recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative vocal performance and in songwriting (if new) of a contemporary Christian pop, rap/hip-hop, Latin, or rock recording (singles or tracks, vocal only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) & Songwriter(s) of new material. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s) & Songwriter(s) of new material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Gospel Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional or contemporary/R&B gospel music recordings (albums, vocal only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording. For choir/chorus albums, recognition goes to the choir director or choral director at Academy discretion. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Contemporary Christian Music Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of Contemporary Christian Music, including pop, rap/hip-hop, Latin, and rock (albums, vocal only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Roots Gospel Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional/roots gospel music (including country, Southern gospel, bluegrass, Americana) (albums, vocal only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Pop Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of Latin pop and urban music styles and culture; includes balladeers and commercial Latin music and is not limited to any one region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Música Urbana Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Encompasses music with greater than 50% Spanish lyrics, originating in reggaeton and other Latin urban styles, including rap, house, R&B, trap, and others (albums, vocal or instrumental).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Latin Rock or Alternative Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin rock or alternative music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of the Latin music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible. Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Música Mexicana Album (Including Tejano)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in recordings of Música Mexicana including styles such as banda, norteño, corridos, gruperos, mariachi, rancheros, sierreño, jarocho, huasteco and huapango, as well as Tejano music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible albums utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation reflecting the broad spectrum of música Mexicana and Tejano styles and cultures. Albums with greater than 50% Spanish language lyrics or albums with music content primarily of a traditional Mexican music genre in style are eligible. Musical style determines eligibility, not ethnicity of performer(s). Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Tropical Latin Album
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in tropical Latin music recordings, including traditional and contemporary tropical styles like salsa, merengue, vallenato, cumbia, and bachata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees are Artist(s) of greater than 50% playing time on the album. GRAMMY statuettes awarded to Artist(s), Producer(s), Engineer/Mixer(s), if other than Artist(s), of greater than 50% playing time on the album.
